vulnerabilities.description: Sensitive field 'password' is not marked with @JsonIgnore and may be exposed in API responses.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Add @JsonIgnore annotation above the password field to prevent serialization.

vulnerabilities.description: Controller method binds @RequestBody directly to entity class 'User' without DTO layer. This allows clients to modify any field.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Create a UserDTO class with only modifiable fields. Map DTO to entity in service layer.
